integrity: The proof is self-contained except for the explicitly derived classical Gauss-sum identity. Finite verification is independent of and does not establish the general theorem; no independent audit has been conducted.
scientific_limitations: The full subalgebra criterion holds for every field and any symmetric bilinear form; the closed rank polynomial requires finite odd field and nondegenerate form. Classical orthogonal isotropic-space counting is used as a standard input. The result does not classify automorphism orbits or isomorphism types.
title: Subalgebra Grassmannians of a bilinear pre-Lie algebra
